name: Hive'Ashi
summary: Across northern Silithus, Hive'Ashi sends its silithid swarms through sand and tunnel. It is one of three great hives in the region, with workers, defenders, and stingers moving over towering mounds.

sections.title: The Northern Mound
sections.body: In northern Silithus, Hive'Ashi's chitinous spires mark the ground claimed by a silithid swarm rising again. Workers forage while venomous defenders move south and east toward the Swarming Pillar. Beneath the mounds, dangerous tunnels shelter the colony. To learn what stirs in the desert, travelers must enter them.

sections.title: A Threat Unearthed
sections.body: Cenarion scouts keep watch on Hive'Ashi. They send combatants to thin the swarm and bring back reports from deep in the colony. Glyphs and coordinated behavior found in Ashi suggest the insects share a single will, though they seem mindless. Their numbers are swelling, and those guarding the southern borders make destroying the brood a priority before it spreads beyond northern Silithus.

faq.answer: Hive'Ashi is an active silithid colony in northern Silithus. Thousands of burrowing insects hollow the desert into linked tunnels and mounds.

faq.q: What kinds of silithid live in Hive'Ashi?
faq.answer: Hive'Ashi shelters workers, sandstalkers, venomous stingers, and heavily armored defenders.

faq.q: How does Hive'Ashi relate to the Swarming Pillar?
faq.answer: Silithids spread outward from Hive'Ashi across the desert floor and swarm around the nearby Swarming Pillar.

faq.q: Why are Cenarion scouts studying this hive?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle studies the silithid resurgence and how the hives coordinate. Scouts watch Ashi's strange glyphs and track how quickly the colony expands.

angles.text: The Cenarion Circle watches Silithus's corrupted sands. As a druid, you are called to study and suppress the insect menace pouring from Hive'Ashi before it engulfs the natural world.
As an Alliance operative in Silithus, you help gather intelligence on Hive'Ashi so its aggressive swarms do not threaten neighboring lands across southern Kalimdor.
